learning_objective: 🎯 To learn that we should not trust false praise or flattery, and always use our own wisdom before acting!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A raven finds a delicious piece of food and sits on a high tree branch to eat it peacefully. He feels very lucky and proud of his prize.
A hungry and clever fox sees the food. Instead of trying to jump or fight, the fox decides to use sweet and fake words to trick the bird.
The fox praises the raven's beauty and begs to hear his sweet voice. The vain raven, wanting to show off, opens his beak to sing.
As soon as the raven opens his beak, the food falls straight into the fox's mouth! The raven learns that not everyone who says sweet words is a true friend.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Act it Out!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are the raven. What smart reply could you have given to the fox to keep your food safe? Write a funny dialogue!

quick_recap: ⭐ The raven sat in a tree with a tasty morsel of food.
⭐ A clever fox used sweet words and flattery to trick him.
⭐ The foolish raven opened his mouth to sing, dropping the food.
⭐ The moral of the story is to beware of flatterers!
